component.name: UnLauncher
component.summary: Install, update and open Unreal Engine on Linux

description.p: UnLauncher is a native launcher for Unreal Engine on Linux. It keeps your engines, projects and Fab assets in one place, and it shares the engine list with the Unreal Editor.

ul.li: A library of your engines and projects, with thumbnails
Installs prebuilt engines from Epic: sign in, pick a version and UnLauncher downloads, extracts and registers it
Builds Unreal Engine from its GitHub source, with a requirements check
Browses your Fab library and adds assets to a project or an engine
Tracks downloads, imports and builds as tasks you can pause or cancel
Opens .uproject files with a double click and adds per-engine shortcuts to your application menu

description.p: The Unreal Editor and engine builds run on your system, outside the sandbox.
UnLauncher is not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games. Unreal Engine, Fab and Epic Games are trademarks of Epic Games, Inc.
